thread:
morgan: Heads-up — eu-north1 local NVMe IOPS spiking for the last ~15m, janitor backlog climbing, ~120 GPU pods Pending due to scratch attach failures. Anyone oncall or has seen this? :warning:
oncall-bot: Alert: nvme_io_pressure detected in eu-north1 — severity: high, triggered 12:28 UTC. AlertID: nvme-eun1-20250606
sasha: I'm looking. Dashboard shows scrub queue length jumped 10 -> 400 at ~12:10 UTC. Lots of scrub/rebalance + batch launch overlap. :eyes:
jamie: confirmed from k8s events: repeated AttachVolumeTimeout and IO timeout on /dev/nvme0n1, some worker pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff while waiting for scratch attach.
priyanka: if janitor is doing deep scrubs we should throttle it or pause to let provisioning finish. Backlog is bad but provisioning > backlog for now. :thinking_face:
sasha: attempting a safe throttle — scaling janitor down to 1 replica first. Command:```kubectl -n infra scale deployment/janitor --replicas=1 --context=prod-eun1```
morgan: if that doesn't drop attach latencies fast, consider replicas=0 for immediate relief (we'll accept backlog growth).
sasha: scaled to 0 for quick relief, also patching configmap to set SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=2 (was 8). Patch cmd:```kubectl -n infra patch cm janitor-config -p '{"data":{"SCRUB_CONCURRENCY":"2"}}'```
janitor-bot: Janitor deployment scaled 6 -> 0 by sasha at 2025-06-06T12:40:20Z
jamie: telemetry: Pending GPU pods dropped from ~120 -> ~32 in 6m after scale down. Attach latency 95th now down from 1.4s -> 210ms.
priyanka: good short-term. reminder this trades off longer-term wear metrics because scrubs will concentrate later. We'll need a controlled catch-up window.
alex: proposal for follow-up: add dynamic backpressure to janitor: do not start scrub batches when attach latency > 200ms or attach fail rate > 1%. Add per-AZ concurrency caps. I'll add to infra roadmap.
morgan: also flagging cost/ops impact — roughly 2.3k GPU-hours delayed for customer jobs this window, we should notify finance/ops briefly. :money_with_wings:
sasha: opened MR infra#4123 to add attach-safety guards and dynamic throttle. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4123
priyanka: creating retro ticket and will propose scheduled low-traffic scrub windows + rate limiter, and an emergency switch to preserve provisioning IO.
morgan: thanks all. If it resurfaces ping here and escalate to SRE oncall. :thumbsup:
